title: Prepare promised publications
sourceConflict: Someone saved a new source version. Your text is preserved against its original version. Compare the stored text before explicitly loading the current version.
resetSource: Replace my text with the current source
reviewConflict: The review changed while you were editing. Your resolutions are preserved and cannot be applied to the new version. Explicitly load the saved review before continuing.
resetReview: Discard my changes and load the saved review
saveBeforeRun: Save the review draft or explicitly discard its changes before starting a new indexing run.
apply: Apply reviewed benefits to the agreement
formScope: This form applies the selected review with its source and versions. Document benefits and review every clause before confirming with the dossier identifier.
replaceDraft: Replace the entered benefits with the saved review draft?
localNotice: Deterministic local indexing of the stored text. No external provider or AI model is used. A person must document quantities, destinations and formats.

source.title: Original agreement — private source
source.name: Source title
source.help: Copy the relevant agreement text (up to {{max}} characters). A new version automatically queues local indexing. Identical content does not start another run. Content is treated as data, never as instructions.
source.save: Save and index a source version

manualHelp: Manual qualification remains available in the agreement form, even when assistance is unavailable.
stale: The source or commitment changed after this run. Read current facts and start a new run before using the proposal.
failed: The run did not finish successfully. Refresh its state, start a new run if available, or complete the agreement manually.
suggestion: Located clauses and publications to document
mappingHelp: Review every excerpt. Document benefits in the usual form, then link each representable clause to a benefit. Indexing does not infer an offer.

attention.human_mapping_required: A person must establish the mapping.
attention.unsupported_terms: This clause may contain terms the commitment model cannot represent. Including it prevents assisted application.

dispositions.unsupported: Unrepresentable contractual term — manual handling required

unsupportedHelp: A real contractual term that cannot be represented needs manual handling. Do not exclude it to enable application. “Outside the contractual scope” only corrects a detection with no contractual meaning and requires an explanation.
applied: The business workflow qualified the agreement. Refresh the receipt to see which controls are satisfied.
separation: Indexing or saving a draft does not satisfy a control. Applying requires the owner's explicit confirmation and publishes nothing.

errors.forbidden: Your permissions no longer allow this assistance. Private data was cleared.
errors.unavailable: Assistance is unavailable. Retry the read or complete the agreement manually.
errors.uncertain: The command result needs verification. Current facts were read without repeating the command.
errors.stale: Facts or versions changed. Read the source and review again before continuing.
errors.timeout: The run remains pending beyond the tracking period. Refresh its state or use manual qualification.
errors.reviewInvalid: Check the review reason and mappings to documented benefits.
